关于是否应该积极使用上下文压缩技术，目前存在很多争议。

研究表明，通过频繁压缩处理，前沿语言模型在众多需要长期预测和需要处理长序列数据的任务上，其准确性几乎不会受到显著影响。

posts.text:
Super interesting finding on optimizing agent harnesses.

When you optimize an agent harness for both quality and cost, apply your cost preference only at the end of the search, since applying it at every step throws away harnesses that lead to better ones.

That is the key
